title: Three Augusts and One Short Wall
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：heat　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 heat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the forecaster ① measured the heat that no traveller in the station would have described, and he said the measuring was the whole of the August. The ② heat, meaning the warmth itself and not the wall, ran three Augusts and stayed undescribed in the book; heat, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of heat in that station had the same short wall beside it, and the ④ heat at the far yard, meaning the glare they kept for the children to escape and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Heat, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the forecaster said the describing is the part that fills three Augusts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the heat was the whole of the matter, meaning the pressure and not the warmth. The ⑥ heat, meaning the pressure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; heat, he said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both warmth and a pressure. He said the pressure is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ heat had become a line in a table, and the table had become an argument about the short wall. The ⑧ heat of the whole thing, the forecaster wrote in July, was one station and three Augusts of describing; heat, he said, is either the glare at the far yard or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ heat I remember is the heat described in the table, which closed in 1990 and is still described as the quietest in the station. ⑩ Heat, my mother said in 1992, is the only thing that improves by being described; all heat, she said, is a pressure that has agreed to look like warmth. She said the pressure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 高温；暑气（指气象站里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 高温；暑气（指那轮暑气本身，与墙相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure the heat 测量高温
D. n. 高温；暑气（指留给孩子们学着躲开的那一轮）
E. n. 暑热（抽象总称，指一处气象站的暑气之事）
F. n. 高温；暑气（指记录表里写到、被记下的的那一轮）
G. n. 重压、煎熬（指一件事里人人都躲却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 煎熬（抽象总称，指人人都躲却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: measured the heat that no traveller in the station would have described
The heat, meaning the warmth itself and not the wall
Every kind of heat in that station
the heat at the far yard
the heat was the whole of the matter
the heat had become a line in a table
The heat of the whole thing

answers.why: measure the heat 意为“测量高温”，1983 年那位预报员把气象站里没有一位赶路人肯描述的暑气做了一遍。
heat 意为“高温；暑气”，指那轮暑气本身而不是墙，它经过了三个八月而在簿子上没有被描述。
heat 意为“高温；暑气”，指气象站里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一道矮矮的院墙。
heat 意为“高温；暑气”，指最远那个院子留给孩子们学着躲开的那一轮，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
heat 意为“重压、煎熬”，指一件事里人人都躲却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份重压就是那件事的全部。
heat 意为“煎熬”，指人人都躲却无人提起的那样东西而不是那轮暑气，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
heat 意为“高温；暑气”，指记录表里写到、被记下的的那一轮，到 1988 年这一轮成了记录表里的一行。
heat 意为“暑热”，预报员七月写道，整件事的暑气之事是一处气象站和三个八月的描述。
heat 意为“高温；暑气”，我记得的是记录表里描述过的那一轮，1990 年消退了，至今仍被说成气象站里最安静的一轮。
heat 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，暑气是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的暑气。
